content.text: {"core": "Creation closes the loop — it is the point where everything that was becoming finally lands as a thing that exists. In Wisdom, that landing presses on deep knowing itself: the accumulated understanding that sits still, waiting. Overdone, completion crowds the waiting out. Every open question gets forced to a conclusion before it has finished teaching, and the stillness that lets insight ripen goes quiet.", "sheetLine": "Every open question gets pushed to an answer before it is done."}
